name: comp-328
title: Card Details Dialog
description: A trigger opens a dark dialog to replace a saved card: name, card number with brand detection, expiry and CVC side by side, a default-payment checkbox and an Update card button.
use: A signed-in user needs to replace or update their saved card in a quick modal.
avoid: It depends on a third-party card-input library and offers no submit or validation feedback.
a11y: Card fields are labelled and the brand icon hidden, but Update card has no handler or validation feedback. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Card details button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a wallet icon, a bold Update your card title and grey line, a Name on card field, a Card Number field with a small card icon at the right, Expiry date and CVC side by side, a muted checkbox line and a white full-width Update card.
behaves: Opening focuses the first field. Typing a card number formats it and swaps the generic card glyph for the brand mark; the expiry also formats as you type. Update card does nothing, and the X or Escape closes.
customise: Labels, checkbox text and button label are fixed in the file; number and expiry formatting come from the card-input library.
weight: light: One dialog and four inputs; the card library only formats entered values.
demo: Filled example uses Maya Chen, card 4242 4242 4242 4242 and expiry 12 / 28.
issues: Update card has no handler, so the card is never saved.
The card brand glyph is decorative but only the generic icon carries aria-hidden.
polishWhy: Tidy payment form with automatic card branding; the inert submit is the only flaw.
